intro: Slack for technical support staff on Mac is best managed with keyboard shortcuts and a voice assistant like Lazur to stay focused. You can reduce context switching and speed up ticket documentation by using voice commands to manage your Slack workspace.
tldr: Use Command + K to switch between channels and direct messages instantly.
Hold Option + Command to ask Lazur about any Slack setting or message on your screen.
Clear your Slack cache via Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart if the app slows down.
Dictate technical responses directly into the Slack input field using the fn key.
Use Shift + Enter for new lines so you do not send half-finished messages.

blocks.text: Mastering Slack keyboard shortcuts on Mac

Technical support staff rely on speed. Your hands should stay on the keyboard. Press Command + / in Slack to view the full list of shortcuts. The Quick Switcher is your most valuable tool. Press Command + K to search for any channel or person. This prevents you from clicking through the sidebar.

items: Command + K: Open the Quick Switcher.
Command + Shift + A: Open the All Unreads view.
Command + T: Open the Threads view.
Command + F: Search in the current channel.

blocks.text: Using Lazur to manage Slack communication

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It helps you navigate Slack without searching through menus. Hold Option + Command while looking at Slack to ask about any UI element. If you forget how to pin a message or set a reminder, just ask Lazur. It will circle the button or explain the steps.

Support staff often deal with heavy Slack workspaces. If the app lags, clear the cache. Go to the Help menu in the menu bar. Select Troubleshooting. Choose Clear Cache and Restart. This often resolves performance issues caused by large history files.
Always keep your Mac updated to macOS 14 Sonoma or newer to ensure the Slack desktop app runs the latest version, 4.53.x.
blocks.title: Keep Slack updated

blocks.text: Writing documentation after a ticket is time-consuming. You can use the fn key to dictate your resolution notes into Slack or your ticketing system. This saves time and ensures you document steps while they are fresh in your mind. Lazur handles the formatting so you can focus on the technical details.

Support staff lose focus when switching between tools. Minimize the time spent in Slack by using status updates. Press Command + Shift + Y to set your status. Let teammates know you are on a call or troubleshooting a server. This reduces incoming interruptions.

Standard search is often too broad. Use modifiers to find specific ticket updates. Use from:@username to find messages from a specific engineer. Use in:#channel-name to filter by location. Combine these to find exactly what you need in seconds.

faq.question: How do I clear Slack cache on Mac?
faq.answer: Go to the Help menu in the top menu bar, select Troubleshooting, and click Clear Cache and Restart.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Slack for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you through steps, but it does not perform clicks or operate the Slack app on your behalf.

faq.question: What is the best shortcut for switching channels?
faq.answer: Press Command + K to open the Quick Switcher, then type the name of the channel or person you want to jump to.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on older macOS versions?
faq.answer: Lazur is designed for modern macOS. Slack itself requires macOS 14 Sonoma or higher for the latest versions.
